newsitem.title: POLAND: Polish cellphone firm Polkomtel to sign loan deal.
newsitem.headline: Polish cellphone firm Polkomtel to sign loan deal.

text.p: One of Poland's two digital cellular phone operators, Polkomtel SA, will sign on Wednesday an agreement with eight banks led by Bank Handlowy SA on a loan of about $220 million, Polkomtel's spokesman said.

Leszek Kaminski told Reuters on Tuesday the loan agreement, which would provide Polkomtel with funds for the expansion of its network, was still being hammered out and its final details would be announced on Wednesday.

"The planned agreement with eight banks concerns about $220 million for projects linked to the expansion of our network but its final details will be available only after its signing tomorrow," Kaminski said.

Polkomtel, an international consortium which groups Danish Tele Danmark, U.S. AirTouch Communications, Polish copper concern KGHM SA, the Plock oil refinery and the National Power Grid (PSE) markets its products under the Plus GSM brand.
Polkomtel said earlier this month it hoped to boost the number of subscribers to 200,000 this year from 50,000 at the end of 1996. -- Warsaw Newsroom +48 22 653 9700.
